description: This file contains the implementation of the onboarding user interface and controller logic for a macOS application. It includes classes for managing the onboarding window, presenting views, and handling onboarding state and workflow.

classes.name: OnboardingController
classes.description: Manages the onboarding window lifecycle including showing, closing, and restarting the onboarding process.

classes.name: OnboardingView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that manages the onboarding user interface, including various setup steps and user interaction logic.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the onboarding window, initializing it if necessary, or bringing it to the front.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the onboarding window if it exists.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Closes and then re-shows the onboarding window to restart the onboarding process.
